analysis.title: Tokenization, 24/7 Trading, and the Economics of Solana
key_insights: Bitwise argues investors underestimate Solana's growth potential as financial activity moves onchain, with tokenization expected to be the main driver of network activity and revenue over the next five years.
Solana processed 4.73B transactions in Sept 2026, 65.7% of the total across Solana and 17 other major chains. Median Q3 2026 fee was $0.00057, over 100x cheaper than Ethereum L1 ($0.08513).
Base fees were only about $7.1M in Q3 2026, but users paid $69M in total fees. The top 1% of transactions paid 67.3% of fees and the top 10% paid 87.1%, reflecting ordering and priority value.
Bitwise frames Solana as a platform like Apple's App Store rather than a commoditizable exchange. Apps earning over $100K a year doubled from 54 to 107 since Jan 2025.

Solana apps earned $3.56B since start of 2025, about 27% more than Ethereum and Hyperliquid L1 apps combined. The top ten apps earned $1.1B (85% of Solana app revenue), nine of them trading apps, and four memecoin platforms earned $707M.

Solana's share of combined network and app revenue fell to 15% by Sept 2026 from nearly half in early 2025. Network fees still rose from $17M to $27M a month between July and September as app revenue nearly doubled.

Tokenized stocks and ETFs total $3.3B (about $1 in every $47,000 of listed equity value), up nearly 5x from about $0.7B at the start of 2026. Regulatory, issuer, broker and exchange progress is cited, including an SEC-approved Nasdaq rule and a five-year exemption, with Nasdaq tokens expected Q2 2027.

Solana DEXs handled $719B of spot volume Jan to Sep 2026, versus Ethereum's $383B (31% of all-chain volume). Solana took 42% of onchain tokenized equity trading ($13.4B of $31.4B), with 2,023 products worth $669M across 630,000 wallets.

Network upgrades: compute limit raised from 60M to 100M units, slot times cut from 400ms to 200ms, and Alpenglow cut confirmation from 12 seconds to about 150ms. No network-wide outage since Feb 2024.
Valuation uses 2031 Real Economic Value (REV) times a multiple, discounted at 20% over five years. REV is $2.80B bear, $6.75B base and $12.83B bull, versus $278M annualized today.
Price outlook for 2031 is $80 bear, $385 base and $1,100 bull, with present values of $32, $155 and $442. Network value is $56B, $270B and $770B.

Base case needs about 21,000 TPS on average and 12x today's transaction load. Tokenized stocks alone would need a block compute limit 2.5x higher in base and 5x in bull. Solana currently trades at roughly 230x revenue versus a 40x base multiple.

Key risks: regulation, outages and governance, slower adoption, competition from Ethereum, L2s, Robinhood and Base, fee capture leakage via offchain ordering deals, scaling, validator decentralization, security and quantum threats, and model risk.

sector_views.rationale: Bitwise sees Solana as uniquely positioned to capture tokenized asset flows, with base case 2031 price outlook of $385 versus roughly $100 SOL today.

crypto_views: SOL base case 2031 price outlook is $385 (bear $80, bull $1,100), with present values of $155 (base), $32 (bear) and $442 (bull), using a 20% discount rate.
Solana trades at roughly 230x revenue against a 40x base case multiple, so the thesis relies on revenue growth of about 24x in the base case rather than multiple expansion.
Validators approved faster SOL disinflation in August 2026. If it goes live in 2027, Bitwise expects SOL supply of 700M in 2031 versus about 635M today.
Half of base fees are burned. Staker yield is mostly from issuance now, but fees are expected to make up a larger share as activity grows and inflation falls.
Solana hosts $15B of the roughly $300B stablecoin supply. Monthly stablecoin payments on the network grew almost fivefold this year to $3.3B, with Visa, Stripe and Western Union building on it.
Tokenized asset trading volume on Solana exceeded $8.3B in Q3 2026. Monthly tokenized equity volume peaked at $4.4B in Sep 2026, versus $3.5B in Jun 2026.
Competition: Ethereum and L2s hold most tokenized assets by value, led by Treasuries and funds. Robinhood and Base have distribution advantages.
risk_factors: Regulatory reversal or opposition from incumbents to tokenization, plus non-US rules limiting who can trade tokenized stocks.
Network outage, difficult upgrades, validator concentration or governance disputes eroding institutional trust.
Slower or narrower onchain adoption than assumed.
Competition from Ethereum, L2s, Robinhood Chain and Base.
Ordering value leaking via offchain deals that bypass Jito tips and priority fees, lowering fees per dollar traded.
Scaling needs of 12x the transaction load and 2.5x to 5x block compute for tokenized stocks.
Security exploits, AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and the quantum computing threat.
Model risk from multiple, trade size and tokenized volume assumptions.

tension_points.bull_case: Solana is an App Store-like platform where apps earn real revenue, and ordering value from priority fees and tips grows as trading moves onchain, supporting REV rising from $278M to $6.75B in the base case.
tension_points.bear_case: Critics say blockchains get commoditized like stock exchanges, and apps and validators could sell ordering value offchain, bypassing Jito tips and priority fees.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Fees per dollar of value traded falling well below today's levels (base case assumes about 3.7 bps take rate) or Solana losing tokenized stock share toward the 30% bear case.

theme_stances.key_argument: Solana's speed, network effects and low cost position it to capture half of tokenized stock trading by 2031.
theme_stances.evidence: investors underestimate its growth potential as more financial activity moves onchain
